title: Letter to Edward Partridge and Others, 30 March 1834
source_note: JS, Letter with postscript by Oliver Cowdery, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to Edward Partridge, William W. Phelps, and other members of the United Firm, [Clay Co., MO], 30 Mar. 1834. Featured version copied [ca. 30 Mar. 1834] in Oliver Cowdery, Letterbook, 30–38; handwriting of Thomas Burdick; Henry E. Huntington Library, San Marino, CA. Transcription from digital color image obtained from the Huntington Library in 2011. For more complete source information on Oliver Cowdery, Letterbook, see the source note for Letter to J. G. Fosdick, 3 Feb. 1834.
